name: Coal

It is formed from plant remains that have been compacted, hardened and chemically altered, and metamorphosed by heat and pressure over geologic time.

name: Cannabis products
description: This group comprises cannabis viable seeds and vegetative plants; fresh and dried cannabis (buds and leaves); cannabis oil; other cannabis extracts and concentrates; cannabis-infused edible products; and other cannabis products n.e.c., for non-medical (recreational, wellness, lifestyle, spiritual, etc.) and medical uses. A plant of the genus Cannabis refers generally to three varieties which are cannabis Sativa, cannabis Indica and cannabis Ruderalis. Sativas and Indicas are the most commonly used cannabis strains for cultivation and propagation. The genetics of the different cannabis strains are widely mixed or cloned to create cannabis hybrids. Cannabis contains a number of active elements, including cannabinoids such as tetrahydrocannabinol (THC) or dronabinol, cannabidiol (CBD) and terpenes (aromatic compounds or chemical markers). Cannabis plants containing 0.3% w/w (weight for weight) of THC or less in the flowering tops and leaves - industrial hemp - and their derivatives with the THC concentration of 10 µg/g or less, as well as prescription drugs or pharmaceuticals containing cannabis, are excluded from this group.

The published products can be acquired or accessed on a physical form or media, or online. They are published on own account for sale by the publishers. Wholesaling and retailing services are excluded from this group.

name: Software and software licensing
description: This group comprises published software sold with an end user licence agreement (by the publisher), and licences to use software or software components to generate revenues.

name: Transportation of commodities by pipeline
description: This group comprises transportation of natural gas, crude oil, refined petroleum products and other commodities by pipeline.

name: Freight transportation by road
description: This group comprises transportation services by truck and other motorized road vehicles (including rental and leasing with operator or driver), for general and specialized freight.

name: Other freight transportation services and air specialty services
description: This group comprises transportation services (including rental and leasing with operator or crew) such as rail, water and air freight; moving services; and air specialty services.

name: Postal and courier services
description: This group comprises postal services; and courier, parcel, and local messenger and delivery services.

name: Passenger transportation services (including sightseeing)
description: This group comprises urban transit services; taxi and limousine services; interurban and rural bus passenger transportation services; school bus services; other transit and passenger transportation services by road; rail passenger transportation services; water passenger transportation services; air passenger transportation services; and scenic and sightseeing tour services. Rental and leasing services of passenger vehicles with operator, driver or crew are included.

name: Transportation support services
description: This group comprises road transportation support services; motor vehicle maintenance and repair services; rail transportation support, maintenance and repair services; water transportation support, maintenance and repair services; air transportation support services; aircraft maintenance and repair services; freight transportation arrangement and customs brokering services; and other transportation support services.

name: Warehousing and storage services

name: Wholesale services (except commissions)
description: This group comprises the services of buying and selling merchandise on own account at an intermediate step in the distribution chain. Wholesale services bundled with services incidental to the own account sale of merchandise such as logistics, inventory management, marketing services, packaging and labeling, handling of warranty claims, in-store or co-op promotions, and product training are also included.

name: Wholesale trade commissions
description: This group comprises the services of arranging the buying or selling of merchandise for others on a commission basis at an intermediate step in the distribution chain.

name: Retail services (except commissions)
description: This group comprises the services of buying and selling merchandise on own account at the final step in the distribution chain, and rendering services incidental to the retail sale of merchandise; the services are provided in-store, on-line or in vending machines.

name: Retail trade commissions
description: This group comprises the service of selling and renting merchandise for others on a commission basis at the final step in the distribution process.

name: Repair and maintenance services (except for buildings and transportation equipment)
description: This group comprises repair and maintenance services, except for buildings and transportation equipment. Covers maintenance and repair services for commercial and industrial machinery and equipment; maintenance and repair services for electronic and precision equipment; and maintenance and repair services for personal and household goods.

name: Rental and leasing (except rental of real estate)
description: This group comprises rentals and operating leases of motor vehicles (except with operator or driver); computer equipment; office furniture and equipment; communication equipment, commercial and industrial machinery and equipment (except with operator); and other goods.

name: Residential buildings

name: Non-residential buildings

name: Civil engineering works
description: This group comprises civil engineering works (infrastructures) or construction works other than buildings and their associated site works, comprising a structure, such as highways, bridges, pipelines, nuclear power plants, water filtration plants and mine structures (except buildings). Construction works are also the results of operations such as dredging, dewatering or soil stabilization.

name: Industrial intellectual property
description: This group comprises industrial intellectual property, such as patents and industrial designs, produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

name: Originals protected by copyright
description: This group comprises originals protected by copyrights produced on own account for sale with all-attendant rights.

name: Oil and gas and mineral exploration
description: This group comprises certain services used in the search for, discovery and initial delimitation of previously unknown pools of oil or gas, unproven areas or deeper zones of known pools, previously unknown mineral deposits, or the re-evaluation of sub-marginal or neglected mineral deposits.

name: Research and experimental development services
description: This group comprises research and experimental development services in natural sciences, engineering and technology, medical and health sciences, agricultural and veterinary sciences, social sciences, and humanities and the arts. Research and experimental development (R&D) comprise creative and systemic work undertaken in order to increase the stock of knowledge - including knowledge of humankind, culture and society - and to devise new applications of available knowledge. The term R&D refers to three types of activity: basic research, applied research and experimental development. Basic research refers to experimental or theoretical work undertaken primarily to acquire new knowledge of the underlying foundations of phenomena and observable facts, without any particular application or use in view. Applied research refers to original investigation undertaken in order to acquire new knowledge. It is, however, directed primarily towards a specific, practical aim or objective. Experimental development is systematic work, drawing on knowledge gained from research and practical experience and producing additional knowledge, which is directed to producing new products or processes or to improving existing products or processes.

name: Custom software design and development services

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of non-financial intangible assets (except products protected by copyright)

name: Support and custom work services for agriculture, forestry, hunting and fishing
description: This group comprises support services for crop production; support services for animal production, hunting and fishing; support services for forestry; and custom work services for forestry.

name: Mining and oil and gas support services

name: Construction services

name: Manufacturing services

name: Advertising space and time

name: Advertising, public relations, and related services
description: This group comprises exclusive advertising rights, endorsements, and display advertising; advertising intermediary services; direct advertising services; full-service advertising campaigns; advertising creative services; advertising services n.e.c.; and public relations services.

name: Audio and video production services

name: Licensing of rights for commercial use of products protected by copyright (except software)
description: This group comprises licences for the use of intellectual property protected by copyrights, except software, to generate revenues.

name: Telecommunications, broadcasting distribution and related services
description: This group comprises fixed wholesale and retail telecommunications services; fixed wholesale and retail Internet access services; mobile wholesale and retail telecommunications services; cable, satellite, Internet and other fixed or mobile broadcasting distribution services of audiovisual and audio works; and online games, except gambling.

name: Other information technology (IT) and information services
description: This group comprises data processing, hosting and related services, and other information technology (IT) and information services.

name: Financial services (except insurance)
description: This group comprises financial system regulatory services; account and cash management products; loans and other credit financing products; investment products; financial planning services and trust products for individuals, businesses, institutions (except unincorporated) and governments; and products supporting financial services.

name: Pension and life insurance products
description: This group comprises pension and annuity products; and life insurance products.

name: Other insurance services
description: This group comprises health and accident insurance products; vehicle and property insurance products; other non-life insurance products; reinsurance products; and insurance brokerage and other services related to insurance.

name: Real estate services

name: Legal and accounting services
description: This group comprises legal services; and accounting, tax preparation, bookkeeping and payroll services.

name: Architectural, engineering and related services

name: Specialized design services

name: Computer systems design and related services (except software development)
description: This group comprises computer network design and development services; computer systems design, development and integration services; information technology (IT) technical consulting services; and information technology (IT) technical support services.

name: Management, scientific and technical consulting services
description: This group comprises management consulting services; environmental consulting services; and other economic, scientific and technical consulting services.

name: Other professional services

name: Administrative and support services

name: Water, sewer and waste management services

name: Health services

name: Residential and nursing care, social assistance, and child day-care services

name: Education services
description: This group comprises education, instruction, training programs and services. Also covers sports coaching services.

name: Sport and live performance services
description: This group comprises contract production of live performing arts performances, live sporting events, and copyrighted works; sport and performing arts event organization services; career management and representation services of artists, athletes, entertainers and other public figures.

name: Admissions to events, performances, exhibitions, and recreational and heritage institution services
description: This group comprises admissions to live sporting events, live performing arts performances and motion picture film exhibitions, as well as recreational services and heritage institution services.

name: Gambling (net wagers)
description: This group comprises lotteries; table wagering games; gambling machine products; racing and sporting event gambling products; and Internet gambling products.

name: Prepared meals and beverages

name: Traveller accommodation

name: Travel arrangement, reservation and planning services
description: This group comprises reservation services for passenger transportation, cruises, lodging, pre-packaged tours and events; event ticket sales and reservation services, and access to global distribution systems; trip planning services; packaged tours; and other travel arrangement and reservation services.

name: Personal and personal care services

name: Babysitting and other private household services

name: Membership organization services

name: Public administration services
description: This group comprises services of a governmental nature, that is, services related to the enactment and judicial interpretation of laws and their pursuant regulations, and the administration of programs based on them. Services provided by government that are not governmental in nature are classified to the same service categories as equivalent services provided by the private sector.
